title: Chapter 99 Cress
content:
Chapter 99 Cress

The battle in Wana Village is still going on.

Everyone has a trace of fatigue on their faces.

After continuously killing wild beasts, Wang Shuo's level has been raised to level 19.

However, he would rather not have this upgrade speed.

It's mainly too exciting, and his heart can't stand it.

Other people in the territory have also been upgraded several levels, and even the logistics team members are at least level 10.

Wang Shuo found that there are still subtle differences in the level upgrades of everyone.

The logistics team members in charge of the energy tower are obviously higher than those who only transport corpses.

The level of the members of the militia team generally reached about level 15.

As for the cavalry team, it is even higher. Li Weiguo, the lowest level, has also reached level 17.

The experience of killing wild beasts now should be partly from the people who directly killed them, and partly from other people in the territory.

Therefore, even those who did not directly participate in the battle have been upgraded.

If it were another time, everyone would be very happy if the level was upgraded so quickly.

But at this moment, no one showed even a trace of smile on their faces, some were just solemn.

A shot killed a scarlet spider in front of him.

At this time, Wang Shuo noticed that a huge goat walked towards his village with an elegant pace.

[Wild Antelope (ID: Sheep 36234 Cress, Bronze Boss)]

[Level: Level 20]

[Attack Power: 360]

[Defense Power: 80]

[Spirit Power: 3000]

[Health Value: 8000]

[Skills: Confrontation, Angry Blow. ]

Seeing another bronze boss join the battle, Wang Shuo was seriously on guard.

"Li Jianguo, aim the bronze crossbow at the wild antelope boss."

Suddenly, the wild antelope boss accelerated suddenly and rushed straight over.

Hit the city wall hard.

The durability of the light wall that was hit was only more than 1,000.

This time, it was directly scrapped.

"Gong Zheng, prepare to block the gap."

Wang Shuo's pupils suddenly dilated, and he quickly went towards the light wall.

Taking advantage of this time, Wang Shuo mobilized all the firepower and began to focus on the wild antelope.

"-120"

"-150"

"-21"

...

Various injuries continued to appear on its head.

The wild antelope Kress felt pain and attacked the surrounding light walls more frantically.

He came to fight in the front, wanting to test how strong the defense of Wana Village was.

"Stupid human, destroy it!" Kress roared, and another piece of the light wall broke.

Gong Zheng immediately raised a body shield as high as a person and pushed it up.

Gong Zheng, who was upgraded to level 18, now has 3900 HP and 110 defense points.

In addition to the "Brothers United" bond bonus, the HP is increased by 30%, and it is not an exaggeration to say that it is a humanoid boss.

It is mainly two high-level gold equipment, the attributes are really too abnormal.

It's just that the attack power is a little less, only 32 points.

Cress launched a fierce attack on Gong Zheng, but it was just a lot of thunder and little rain.

"-180"

Seeing this damage value, Wang Shuo felt relieved. It seemed that this wild antelope boss could not threaten Gong Zheng.

"You guys, come together!" Cress immediately called several nearby elite monsters to come over to deal with Gong Zheng together.

However, Cress's blood loss speed was obviously much faster than Gong Zheng.

After a while, he couldn't stand it anymore, and then turned and ran.

"Hey, don't run, let's fight to the end!"

Wang Shuo found that the other party had left, and he was a little anxious.

"Damn, a boss with high IQ is not easy to deal with."

Wang Shuo immediately called people over to repair the city wall.

Gong Zheng and others drove the beasts out of the gap.
